notes: The first branch ends at «أبي» after «حدثنا أبي ح»; the second branch («وحدثنا ابن بشار») repeats its own names, so the tail is null.
«نحوه» means the same saying in similar words; a wording remark, left out.
The Companion is the grandfather «جده» (relation, rule 7); the saying «قلت يا رسول الله» is his own.
